governance_layer_2026_09_30.what_changed: Between the 2026-09-29 ls snapshot and this 2026-09-30 archive, the repo gained a full governance layer: docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md (D-001..D-007, open conflicts), docs/DESIGN_BASIS.md (DB-01..DB-13, all TBD pending a licensed engineer), docs/BUILD_RELEASE_GATE.md (repo-wide HOLD disposition + evidence checklist), docs/ENGINEERING_VALIDATION_CALL.md (public call for outside review), .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/engineering-validation.yml (structured submission form). This now supersedes the OQ-1..OQ-9 list this file used to carry - track new open items against their D-/DB- numbers, not a parallel list here.
governance_layer_2026_09_30.authorship: Produced by Google Antigravity (Gemini 3 agent IDE) per Clay, alongside the 13-sheet FreeCAD TechDraw 'revision B' drawing pack under private/Copilot/ and copilot_drowings/.
claude_cross_check_2026_09_30: Flat end caps (5mm) confirmed in BOTH CAD code paths - cad/scripts/generator.py (CAP_THICK=5.0) and the new src/geometry/production_cad.py (CadQuery). A UG-34 screening fails this at EITHER open design-pressure candidate: needs ~12.1mm at 16 bar, ~15.1mm at 25 bar, have 5.0mm. This means D-001 (16 vs 25 bar) does not by itself clear the cap - the geometry needs to change either way. Full numbers in design_audit.py's new check_pressure_candidates().

The 16 bar candidate (results/bom.csv item #1 note) leaves only 2.9% margin over the cycle model's own 15.55 bar operating pressure, and is reached by NH3 saturation pressure alone at just 32C ambient (10K approach) - ordinary for the target climate, not an upset case. 25 bar is not reached until ~49C ambient in the same screening.
D-002's second port-protrusion value (60mm) traced to a concrete source: src/geometry/production_cad.py V101_SPEC['port_protrusion_mm'] = 60.0, vs COMPONENT_SPECS.md's 40mm.

D-005 says the copper-steel silver-brazing line was 'removed from ammonia-system BOM pending review' (dated 2026-09-30) - but results/bom.csv item #32 ('Silver brazing rods 5%... Copper-steel joints', 20pc) is still present as reviewed. Register and artifact are out of sync on this one item.

src/thermo/ammonia_water_iapws.py (new) wraps the real iapws.ammonia.H2ONH3 (IAPWS-2001 standard formulation) - a legitimate independent check for D-007's mixture-validation gap, stronger than the self-comparison of two secondary literature sources or the non-converging teqp path. Not yet run against Ziegler-Trepp's state points.
A validation issue draft matching .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/engineering-validation.yml, carrying the above as a sourced submission, was prepared - see VALIDATION_ISSUE_DRAFT.md.
governance_layer_2026_09_30.cannot_verify_here: This sandbox has no network, so CadQuery/iapws-backed scripts (production_cad.py, ammonia_water_iapws.py) could not be executed here - reviewed as source only. Clay or Antigravity need to actually run them locally to confirm they execute as written.

simulation_validation_2026_10_04.track: Simulation/model validation selected as the next software workstream; hardware remains on HOLD.
cycle_model_changes: src/thermo/cycle_model.py now rejects non-finite inputs, nonpositive cooling load, invalid rich/poor concentration ordering, SHX effectiveness outside [0,1], invalid temperature ordering, invalid generator vapor composition, and generator temperature below the poor-solution bubble point.
tests/test_cycle_model.py adds regression cases for those input guards; targeted result: 9 passed. The existing nominal outputs are unchanged.
simulation_validation_2026_10_04.limitations: These are software input checks, not physical/property validation. The baseline still uses the simplified Ziegler-Trepp/CoolProp assumptions described in docs/wiki/Thermodynamic-Model.md; D-007 remains OPEN and the overall project remains HOLD.
simulation_validation_2026_10_04.pytorch: Not found in tracked project manifests or code, and import fails in the project venv. No PyTorch dependency or ML calculation was added.

reviewed_materials: ASME BPVC Section VIII, Division 1, 2017 edition: extracted searchable text across all 778 PDF pages.
API 520 Part I, Eighth Edition (December 2008): all 146 pages OCR-reviewed.
Duffie & Beckman, Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes, Second Edition: all 469 pages OCR-reviewed.
Incropera et al., Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Sixth Edition: all 999 pages OCR-reviewed.
not_available_or_not_reviewed: ASME Section V, API 521, and API 520 Part II are not present in the project and were not reviewed.

ASME Section IX, 2019 edition: reviewed in multiple ranges, but not a verified complete line-by-line review; extraction/OCR gaps remain and qualification-table values were not checked against a controlled copy. The local copy is third-party sourced.
m112content.pdf is a separate 32-page PDHonline course, Selection and Sizing of Pressure Relief Valves (Randall W. Whitesides, 2026); identity checked but its contents have not yet been reviewed.
reference_review_2026_10_04.edition_status: The local API 520 Part I copy is the Eighth Edition (December 2008). API's official page confirms that the Tenth Edition has been published and is the current offering; the page fetched does not state its publication year, so the year is not confirmed here.
reference_review_2026_10_04.ocr_caveat: API 520 Part I, Duffie & Beckman, and Incropera are scanned copies reviewed via OCR. Page coverage was complete, but equation/table/figure OCR can be inaccurate; verify exact technical values against authoritative source pages before use. These readings do not constitute code approval.
reference_review_2026_10_04.relief_guidance_caveat: Google AI text supplied by the user proposing 37.8% operating margin, a 25-bar setpoint, generic chatter/backpressure thresholds, a specific thermal-relief valve size, or a selected two-phase method is unverified and must not be treated as a project decision or code requirement. 25 bar is not an approved MAWP; DB-05/DB-09 and D-001/D-006 remain OPEN.
reference_review_2026_10_04.project_hold: Reading references and adding model input guards do not close DB/D/build-release items or authorize fabrication, pressure testing, ammonia charging, or operation.

Matches BUILD_RELEASE_GATE.md's own 'V-102 integration' row.
open_questions.recommendation_unchanged: Intermittent batch, single generator/absorber vessel, no solution pump - still the recommendation (no moving parts was the project's own session-1 goal; no pump is in the BOM; hospital 24h need is served by a small ice/PCM buffer, not continuous circulation). This is a genuine engineering decision the project needs, not something either Claude or Antigravity should silently assume.
